content:
**Liquid Courage** is an alcoholic beverage in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *One Wasteland For All*
update.

Liquid Courage is a custom-made brew that provides temporary bonuses of +1 to Luck and Strength. It also provides immunity to Uncontrollable Fear attacks from the Wendigo Colossus and Blue Devil. Because it is an alcoholic beverage, consuming it has a 5% chance of acquiring Alcohol Addiction.
